# Parker to Webcast Annual Meeting of Shareholders on October 28, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern


October 14, 2026 5:00 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ac519b812cd6d28915b662b3049cd85e/parker/news/2026-10-14_Parker_to_Webcast_Annual_Meeting_of_Shareholders_512.pdf)


CLEVELAND, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Parker Hannifin Corporation (NYSE: PH), the global leader in motion and control technologies, will webcast its Annual Meeting of Shareholders, which is scheduled for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 9:00 a.m., Eastern time. The webcast will be accessible at[investors.parker.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=t1bhpYwlCWQH82oKeWk7xvtx1Zd3q0qaNrEko9CBC9xvzs9_aTpWb7OdmSquBtWlyvg6dyRCqI6vVxcJVa38ynSDG7NSHIWl9gksfqVMS94=) and will be archived for one year.


Parker Hannifin is a Fortune 250 global leader in motion and control technologies. For more than a century the company has been enabling engineering breakthroughs that lead to a better tomorrow. Parker has increased its annual dividend per share paid to shareholders for 70 consecutive fiscal years, among the top five longest-running dividend-increase records in the S&P 500 index. Learn more at www.parker.com or[@parkerhannifin](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=47Q9b2Lg9JzzqIGZkUiGc3uBtrTLd-_tlm_liYOhsAm_FH5cvzpT6Yrwg6RLpzRJkwb3ps6pb31VY8JeiU7kxMvK0tF717SUGbSNkXXjO_w=) .
